{
  "type_map": {},
  "constraints": [
    {
      "id": "R1",
      "category": "protocol",
      "alternatives": ["(df['TCP_FLAGS'] == 0) | (df['PROTOCOL'] == 6)"],
      "features": ["TCP_FLAGS", "PROTOCOL"],
      "rationale": "TCP flags are only present for TCP protocol (IP protocol 6)."
    },
    {
      "id": "R2",
      "category": "protocol",
      "alternatives": ["(df['CLIENT_TCP_FLAGS'] == 0) | (df['PROTOCOL'] == 6)"],
      "features": ["CLIENT_TCP_FLAGS", "PROTOCOL"],
      "rationale": "Client TCP flags are only present for TCP protocol."
    },
    {
      "id": "R3",
      "category": "protocol",
      "alternatives": ["(df['SERVER_TCP_FLAGS'] == 0) | (df['PROTOCOL'] == 6)"],
      "features": ["SERVER_TCP_FLAGS", "PROTOCOL"],
      "rationale": "Server TCP flags are only present for TCP protocol."
    },
    {
      "id": "R4",
      "category": "protocol",
      "alternatives": ["(df['RETRANSMITTED_IN_BYTES'] == 0) | (df['PROTOCOL'] == 6)"],
      "features": ["RETRANSMITTED_IN_BYTES", "PROTOCOL"],
      "rationale": "Retransmitted bytes (src->dst) are only present for TCP protocol."
    },
    {
      "id": "R5",
      "category": "protocol",
      "alternatives": ["(df['RETRANSMITTED_IN_PKTS'] == 0) | (df['PROTOCOL'] == 6)"],
      "features": ["RETRANSMITTED_IN_PKTS", "PROTOCOL"],
      "rationale": "Retransmitted packets (src->dst) are only present for TCP protocol."
    },
    {
      "id": "R6",
      "category": "protocol",
      "alternatives": ["(df['RETRANSMITTED_OUT_BYTES'] == 0) | (df['PROTOCOL'] == 6)"],
      "features": ["RETRANSMITTED_OUT_BYTES", "PROTOCOL"],
      "rationale": "Retransmitted bytes (dst->src) are only present for TCP protocol."
    },
    {
      "id": "R7",
      "category": "protocol",
      "alternatives": ["(df['RETRANSMITTED_OUT_PKTS'] == 0) | (df['PROTOCOL'] == 6)"],
      "features": ["RETRANSMITTED_OUT_PKTS", "PROTOCOL"],
      "rationale": "Retransmitted packets (dst->src) are only present for TCP protocol."
    },
    {
      "id": "R8",
      "category": "protocol",
      "alternatives": ["(df['TCP_WIN_MAX_IN'] == 0) | (df['PROTOCOL'] == 6)"],
      "features": ["TCP_WIN_MAX_IN", "PROTOCOL"],
      "rationale": "Max TCP window (src->dst) is only present for TCP protocol."
    },
    {
      "id": "R9",
      "category": "protocol",
      "alternatives": ["(df['TCP_WIN_MAX_OUT'] == 0) | (df['PROTOCOL'] == 6)"],
      "features": ["TCP_WIN_MAX_OUT", "PROTOCOL"],
      "rationale": "Max TCP window (dst->src) is only present for TCP protocol."
    },
    {
      "id": "R10",
      "category": "protocol",
      "alternatives": ["(df['DURATION_IN'] == 0) | (df['PROTOCOL'] == 6)"],
      "features": ["DURATION_IN", "PROTOCOL"],
      "rationale": "Client to server stream duration is only present for TCP protocol."
    },
    {
      "id": "R11",
      "category": "protocol",
      "alternatives": ["(df['DURATION_OUT'] == 0) | (df['PROTOCOL'] == 6)"],
      "features": ["DURATION_OUT", "PROTOCOL"],
      "rationale": "Server to client stream duration is only present for TCP protocol."
    },
    {
      "id": "R12",
      "category": "protocol",
      "alternatives": ["(df['FTP_COMMAND_RET_CODE'] == 0) | (df['PROTOCOL'] == 6)"],
      "features": ["FTP_COMMAND_RET_CODE", "PROTOCOL"],
      "rationale": "FTP command return code is only present for TCP protocol (FTP uses TCP)."
    },
    {
      "id": "R13",
      "category": "protocol",
      "alternatives": ["(df['ICMP_TYPE'] == 0) | (df['PROTOCOL'] == 1)"],
      "features": ["ICMP_TYPE", "PROTOCOL"],
      "rationale": "ICMP type/code is only present for ICMP protocol (IP protocol 1)."
    },
    {
      "id": "R14",
      "category": "protocol",
      "alternatives": ["(df['ICMP_IPV4_TYPE'] == 0) | (df['PROTOCOL'] == 1)"],
      "features": ["ICMP_IPV4_TYPE", "PROTOCOL"],
      "rationale": "ICMP IPv4 type is only present for ICMP protocol."
    },
    {
      "id": "R15",
      "category": "protocol",
      "alternatives": ["(df['DNS_QUERY_ID'] == 0) | (df['PROTOCOL'] == 17) | (df['PROTOCOL'] == 6)"],
      "features": ["DNS_QUERY_ID", "PROTOCOL"],
      "rationale": "DNS query ID is only present for UDP or TCP protocols (DNS typically uses UDP or TCP)."
    },
    {
      "id": "R16",
      "category": "protocol",
      "alternatives": ["(df['DNS_QUERY_TYPE'] == 0) | (df['PROTOCOL'] == 17) | (df['PROTOCOL'] == 6)"],
      "features": ["DNS_QUERY_TYPE", "PROTOCOL"],
      "rationale": "DNS query type is only present for UDP or TCP protocols."
    },
    {
      "id": "R17",
      "category": "protocol",
      "alternatives": ["(df['DNS_TTL_ANSWER'] == 0) | (df['PROTOCOL'] == 17) | (df['PROTOCOL'] == 6)"],
      "features": ["DNS_TTL_ANSWER", "PROTOCOL"],
      "rationale": "DNS TTL answer is only present for UDP or TCP protocols."
    }
  ]
}
